mapper.select: SELECT t.tent_id::text AS "id",t.opp_id AS "opportunityId",o.proj_id AS "projectId", t.dev_id AS "developerId",n.job_cd AS "jobCode",t.tent_stat_cd AS "status", d.use_yn AS "developerUseYn",p.proj_stat_cd AS "projectStatus",p.ctrt_end_dt AS "projectEndDate",t.proc_dttm AS "processedAt" FROM tb_sl_tent_asgn t JOIN tb_sl_opp o ON o.opp_id=t.opp_id JOIN tb_sl_opp_need n ON n.opp_id=t.opp_id AND n.need_sn=t.need_sn JOIN tb_hr_dev d ON d.dev_id=t.dev_id LEFT JOIN tb_pj_proj p ON p.proj_id=o.proj_id WHERE t.tent_id=CAST(#{id} AS numeric)

SELECT h.aft_val FROM tb_sy_chg_hist h JOIN tb_sy_chg_hist s ON s.trgt_tbl_nm=h.trgt_tbl_nm AND s.trgt_key=h.trgt_key AND s.chg_item_nm='sourceTentId' AND s.aft_val=#{id} JOIN tb_pj_asgn a ON a.asgn_id=h.aft_val WHERE h.trgt_tbl_nm='TB_SL_TENT_ASGN' AND h.trgt_key=#{id} AND h.chg_item_nm='assignmentId' ORDER BY h.hist_id LIMIT 1
SELECT opp_id FROM tb_sl_opp WHERE opp_id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT tent_id::text FROM tb_sl_tent_asgn WHERE tent_id=CAST(#{id} AS numeric) FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_sl_tent_asgn SET tent_stat_cd=#{status},proc_dttm=#{now},mod_user_id=#{actor},mod_dttm=#{now} WHERE tent_id=CAST(#{id} AS numeric) AND opp_id=#{opportunityId} AND tent_stat_cd='CNVT'
UPDATE tb_sl_opp SET mod_user_id=#{actor},mod_dttm=#{now} WHERE opp_id=#{opportunityId}
